What it does

FieldEdge has been around long enough to be trade-specific in the details that matter — dispatch boards, price books and accounting integration for HVAC, plumbing and electrical work. The interface is less modern than newer competitors and pricing is not published, which makes evaluation slower, but it remains a serious option for mid-sized firms.

Where the AI actually is

Includes AI-assisted scheduling and reporting features.

Pros

  • Trade-specific rather than generic
  • Integrates with common accounting systems
  • Good dispatch board

Cons

  • Less modern interface than newer competitors
  • Pricing is not transparent

Who it suits

Built with HVAC, Plumbers, Electricians in mind. Mid-sized trade businesses outgrowing entry-level apps.

Alternatives

  • Contractor Foreman

    All-in-one construction management at a lower price point.

  • Housecall Pro

    Scheduling, dispatch, invoicing and payments for home service businesses.

  • Jobber

    Field service management for small home service teams.

  • ServiceTitan

    Enterprise field service platform for larger trade businesses.
